You have enough capacity in your adrenals to survive long famines and long bouts of stress and challenge. Coffee doesn't drain that. Neither does training hard.

Adrenal insufficiency syndrome is real, and there are real diseases of the adrenals, but that is not what people are describing.

You have plenty of adrenaline to deploy. Movement engages the adrenals to release it, which acts on your vagus, your organs and the locus coeruleus to raise attention and focus.

"Adrenal fatigue" isn't real, but overtraining and true adrenal disease are - see a doctor if deep fatigue persists despite rest.
